day.reading: about 10^52 molecules ever, standing for all useful (Day: functional) proteins

critic.reading: the printed inputs do not give 10^52; the count is of molecules, not functional sequences
critic.note: the 273-order comparison moves by 3 orders at most (M-401)

notes: Eden's p.7 inputs give 1.06e55 (10^55.02), 0.02 orders over his working paper's 'less than 10^55' (a match to rounding) and 3.0 orders above the 10^52 printed in the talk. Day's ch.6 inputs give 3.5e51 (approximately 10^52) only if the 1e-4 concentration is a mass fraction of the whole biosphere volume; read as printed, 10^18 cells per cm^3 means 10 nm cells. Either count is of molecules, not distinct sequences: Eden's own 'say 10^40' species is 12 to 15 orders lower. None of this moves the 273-order gap of M-401 by more than 3 orders.
